string.text: Listen, Vergas, could I give you a hand with anything?
A hand? Hm... There is a snag, boy. Fixing knives is simple enough, but I can't get decent stones. I need a good sharpener, not a worn-out one, in proper shape.
A sharpener? Where would I even find one?

All sorts of ways, all sorts... Whoever looks, finds. Bring one and leave it with me, and I won't shortchange you: your knives will go faster, and cheaper. But it has to be sound, you hear? I have no use for junk.
Vergas, take a look at this. Found a sharpener, like you said. Will it do?
Hm... Hand it here. Good stones, not some homemade junk... With one of these I could put an edge on your knives a lot quicker, and charge you a lot less. Leave it with me?
I'll leave it. Put it to use.
Now that's how it's done. Bring me a knife - I'll fix it up, and fair, I promise.
Vergas, you handle those stones like they're family. Will you teach me too?

Teach you? Simple enough, but there's a knack to it... You have to train the hand, and the eye. I'll show you a couple of secrets, but not for free. Bring me an artifact, any first-level one. Let it earn its keep around here.
Look here. Don't press down on the stone, lead the blade along it... like that. See, it's going better already. The rest is up to your hands, Marked One, only your hands.
